summary: OpenAI announced that GPT-5.6 is now available within the Kiro developer tool, described as offering better price-performance for coding tasks.

practices.reason: A new model version is framed as improving price-performance for developers, but no benchmark or figure is given to act on.
practices.quote: GPT‑5.6 is now available in Kiro, helping developers plan, build, review, and test software with better price-performance.
